title: Explainable Identification of Hate Speech towards Islam using Graph Neural Networks
measurement_description: The paper evaluated the detection and explainability of hate speech directed toward Islam (Islamophobic language) on social media platforms using Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) combined with pretrained NLP word embeddings.
findings: The proposed dual Graph Neural Network approach (XG-HSI-BERT) significantly outperformed traditional and base NLP models in detecting Islamophobic hate speech, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy (0.751) and Macro F1 (0.747). Additionally, the use of GNNExplainer successfully provided clear explainability by highlighting contextual tokens and structural relationships (e.g., negative words juxtaposed with 'Muslim diversity') that drove the model's classifications.
